# .1: Outbreak of the Eurasian Great War & Bloc Leaders' Oath
oe_end.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_end.1.t
	desc = oe_end.1.d
	outcome = neutral
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_end_diplomatic_revolution.dds"
	option = {
		name = oe_end.1.a
		add_prestige = prestige_mild_bonus
		add_war_exhaustion = war_exhaustion_weak_penalty
		if = {
			limit = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_hegemon_aligned_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
		else = {
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_coalition_aligned_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
		}
		situation:oe_sit_eurasian_great_war = {
			if = {
				limit = { root = { oe_end_is_bloc_a = yes } }
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = 4 }
			}
			else = {
				change_variable = { name = oe_end_balance add = -4 }
			}
			clamp_variable = { name = oe_end_balance min = 0 max = 100 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_end.1.b
		add_stability = stability_weak_bonus
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_end_diplomatic_revolution_mod years = 8 mode = replace }
	}
}
